conditions.M2H: clean DISCARD ALL on a backend that never had a temp table (A_never_temp) against one that created, dropped and settled one (B_had_temp)
conditions.M2I: reset after one taint kind, each kind in its own sessions that never see another kind; part after1..after5 = the 1st..5th further DISCARD ALL on the now-clean session
conditions.M2R: ORDER-CONFOUNDED, not a per-kind cost: the first M2 (raw id M2) applied all kinds in one session per round with the order rotated by one, so each kind always followed the same other kind and carries its after-effects; superseded by M2I
conditions.clock: Go monotonic clock; times in ns
conditions.excluded: rows flagged excluded (warm-up, or outside the M7S window) and failed rows are not in stats
conditions.host: shared 4-vCPU VM; probe and server on the same host
conditions.paths: published = 127.0.0.1 port via docker-proxy; bridge = container IP:5432 direct; client = no network
conditions.server: postgres:17 throwaway container, shared_buffers=32MB, max_connections=600 (see each run's env.txt)
